summary: The supplied GIS summary indicates a populated, relatively low-lying area with high riverine flood risk close to a major river.
risk_factors: Flood type is identified as riverine
Flood risk is classified as high
The area is about 700 metres from the river
A hospital is present in the assessed area

interventions.title: Explore creating more space for the river
interventions.reason: A conceptual set-back defence could widen the active floodplain and give high river flows more space, subject to land-use and engineering assessment.
suitable_because: Riverine flooding is the identified hazard
The site is close to the river
The GIS summary identifies broad, mostly undeveloped floodplain patches

map_visualization.description: Show the existing river corridor and a conceptual inland defence line with the intervening area shaded; label it as illustrative only.

interventions.title: Screen floodplain areas for improved conveyance
interventions.reason: Selected floodplain areas might be reshaped to provide more room for high river flows, but terrain and hydraulic data are needed before judging feasibility.
suitable_because: Riverine flooding is the identified hazard
Broad floodplain patches are reported between the settlement and the river

map_visualization.description: Shade broad candidate floodplain areas for further study without assigning excavation depths or exact project boundaries.

interventions.title: Assess site-level protection for the hospital
interventions.reason: Reducing the hospital's vulnerability and protecting access or essential services could limit consequences during a flood.
suitable_because: A hospital is identified in the assessed area
The surrounding flood risk is classified as high

map_visualization.description: Mark the hospital and a conceptual review buffer, including its access routes if those data become available.

limitations: The input values are illustrative and do not constitute a site survey.
No hydraulic simulation, defence-condition assessment, or flood-depth analysis was performed.
Land ownership, displacement, environmental impacts, and downstream effects are unknown.
Conceptual map symbols are not engineering-approved locations or boundaries.
warning: Educational screening only; not an engineering assessment. Flooding may still occur under any mitigation scenario.
